theme.title: The Numbers Game
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: How many more regular-season games did the 2004–05 Suns win than the season before?
questions.note: 33 more wins after Nash's arrival transformed the team.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 33-win improvement over the 2003–04 campaign constituted the third-best year-to-year jump in NBA history.

funFacts.text: Phoenix brought Steve Nash back from Dallas on a major free-agent contract.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Suns re-acquired All-Star guard Steve Nash from the Dallas Mavericks

funFacts.text: Mike D'Antoni's attack prioritized quick ball movement, pick-and-rolls and frequent three-pointers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: emphasized rapid ball movement, pick-and-rolls, and high-volume three-point shooting

funFacts.text: A white memorial patch on the Suns' jerseys honored former coach and broadcaster Cotton Fitzsimmons.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: wearing a white patch on their jerseys for the entire season

questions.prompt: Manute Bol blocked 8 shots in a single quarter in 1985. How many did Elmore Smith block in a half in 1973, an NBA record?
questions.note: 11: six in one quarter and five in the other. Bol tied it in 1985.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 11 blocks in a half, setting the NBA record. 6 blocks in one quarter; 5 blocks in the other quarter

funFacts.text: Smith's record came in a Los Angeles Lakers victory over Portland during the league's first season tracking blocks.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Elmore Smith  | Los Angeles Lakers  | October 28, 1973  | Portland Trail Blazers

funFacts.text: That same performance also included a hefty rebounding total and a triple-double.
Only a few days earlier, Smith had also posted a huge blocked-shot game against Detroit.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Elmore Smith  (2)  | Los Angeles Lakers  | October 26, 1973

questions.prompt: The chart shows four other assist seasons. How many assists per game did LeBron average in his first MVP season?
questions.note: 7.2 assists per game while running Cleveland's attack.

funFacts.text: LeBron also averaged 28.4 points and 7.6 rebounds in the regular season.
In November, LeBron became the youngest player in league history to reach 11,000 career points.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On November 18, LeBron James became the youngest player to reach 11,000 career points

funFacts.text: LeBron overtook Mark Price as Cleveland's all-time steals leader that December.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: LeBron James passed Mark Price to become the Cavaliers' all-time steals leader

questions.prompt: In Game 4 of the 2006 Finals, Miami held Dallas to how many fourth-quarter points?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Miami held Dallas to just seven points in the fourth quarter

funFacts.text: Miami's defense held Dallas to an unusually low final-quarter total in a blowout that tied the series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Mavericks' fourth quarter was the lowest ever by any team during the NBA Finals.

funFacts.text: Jerry Stackhouse was suspended for the next game after a flagrant foul in this contest.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jerry Stackhouse committed a flagrant foul that resulted in his suspension for Game 5.

funFacts.text: Shaquille O'Neal grabbed 13 rebounds in that Miami victory.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Rebs: Shaquille O'Neal 13
